info.name: Walmart Cost Management Assortment Recommendations On Request Reports API

params.name: reportType
params.description:
Specifies the report type for the request. For example, `reportType=INVENTORY_DSV` creates an inventory report. Valid values are: | Value | Meaning | | --- | --- | | INVENTORY_DSV | Creates an inventory report | | ITEM_CONFIGURATION_DATA | Creates an item configuration data report | Example(s):
INVENTORY_DSV
ITEM_CONFIGURATION_DATA

params.name: reportVersion
params.description:
Specifies the version of the created report. Supported versions for each report type include: | Report Type | Supported Version | | --- | --- | | INVENTORY_DSV | v1 | | ITEM_CONFIGURATION_DATA | v1 | Example(s):
v1

params.name: requestStatus
params.description:
Specifies the status of the report request. Valid values include: | Value | Description | | --- | --- | | RECEIVED | Report request has been received | | INPROGRESS | Report request is in progress | | READY | Report request is ready | | ERROR | Report request is in an error state | Example(s):
RECEIVED

params.name: requestSubmissionStartDate
params.description:
Specifies the report submittal start date-timestamp for the range of reports request, in ISO 8601 format. Example(s):
2023-08-28T13:34:54Z

params.name: requestSubmissionEndDate
params.description:
Specifies the report submittal end date-timestamp for the range of reports request, in ISO 8601 format. Example(s):
2023-08-28T15:43:54Z

items.docs:
GET /v3/reports/reportRequests

This API request fetches a list of all report requests based on search criteria like `reportType`, `reportVersion`, and `requestStatus`. Use the query parameters to define the search and fetch details of report requests created in the last 30 days only.

items.docs:
POST /v3/reports/reportRequest

This request creates a new request for a report by specifying the report type and version. In the request body, define one or more attributes to include in the report. The attribute must be a valid attribute for the report. Reference the guide for a list of applicable attributes in each report and definitions. See the On Request Reports<

info.name: Walmart Retrieve Details on Single Report

params.name: requestId
params.description:
Specifies the system-generated identifier associated with the report request. Example(s):
4406b7c3-674e-41e4-a18a-5fd6f123479f

items.docs:
GET /v3/reports/reportRequests/{requestId}

This request fetches the status and other details of a single report request, as queried by the `requestId` path parameter. Fetch details of a report request created in the last 30 days only.
